work_items.title: Queue v2 cutover for eu-west export workers
work_items.description: Cut eu-west export and webhook workers over to queue v2. Blocked on KMS key re-provisioning in eu-west. Owner left the company on 2026-09-30; no replacement assigned in the tracker. Forecast date has passed and was not re-confirmed.
acceptance_criteria: All eu-west export workers consume from queue v2.
Queue v1 drained and decommissioned in eu-west.

work_items.title: Migrate export worker to queue v2
work_items.description: Move the scheduled-export worker from queue v1 to queue v2. Code complete for us-east; eu-west waits on the queue v2 cutover milestone.
acceptance_criteria: Export worker processes schedules from queue v2 in all regions.
No duplicate deliveries during migration.

work_items.title: Restore scheduled exports
work_items.description: Scheduled exports stopped delivering for several customers since 2026-10-11 after the partial worker migration. Scheduled exports are blocked by the export worker migration. Retrying schedules and manual reruns did not restore delivery. No delivery date committed.
acceptance_criteria: Scheduled exports deliver on time for all affected customers for 3 consecutive days.
Affected customers confirm delivery.

work_items.title: Scheduled exports skip a run after DST transition
work_items.description: Schedules defined in a local timezone skip one run on the day of a daylight-saving transition in product version 4.2. Recreating the schedule in UTC avoids the skip for most customers but did not work for Acme's custom fiscal calendar.
acceptance_criteria: Schedules in local timezones fire exactly once on DST transition days.
Regression test covers America/Chicago and Europe/Berlin transitions.

work_items.title: Add S3 bucket destination for scheduled exports
work_items.description: Deliver scheduled export files to a customer-owned S3 bucket using a cross-account IAM role. Out of scope: SFTP, FTPS, Azure Blob and any push into the customer's network.
acceptance_criteria: Customer can configure an S3 bucket and IAM role ARN as an export destination.
Delivery uses the customer's role; no static keys are stored.
SFTP and other push protocols are explicitly not supported by this item.

work_items.title: Spike: SFTP delivery for exports
work_items.description: Two-day investigation into SFTP push delivery. Cancelled on 2026-06-01 when the S3 destination was prioritised. No SFTP work is scheduled.

work_items.title: SCIM user provisioning GA
work_items.description: General availability of SCIM 2.0 /Users endpoint: create, update and deactivate accounts from the IdP.
acceptance_criteria: IdP can create, update and deactivate users via SCIM.
Deactivated users lose access within 5 minutes.

work_items.title: SCIM group sync: support nested IdP groups
work_items.description: Flat group push and role mapping are supported today. Nested groups are flattened incorrectly; this item adds nested group expansion.
acceptance_criteria: Members of nested IdP groups receive the role mapped to the parent group.
Group sync log shows expansion depth.

work_items.title: Deprovisioned SCIM users keep active sessions
work_items.description: Sessions were not revoked when the IdP deactivated a user through SCIM connector v1. Fixed in SCIM connector v2.
acceptance_criteria: Deactivation revokes all sessions and API tokens.

work_items.title: Durable webhook retry queue (24h)
work_items.description: Today webhooks retry with backoff for at most 30 minutes. This item persists undelivered events for 24 hours on queue v2.
acceptance_criteria: Events undelivered for up to 24 hours are retried and delivered in order.
Operators can replay a time window.

work_items.title: Return Retry-After header on 429 responses
work_items.description: Public API now returns Retry-After and X-RateLimit-Remaining headers on throttled responses.
acceptance_criteria: 429 responses include Retry-After in seconds.
Documentation updated.

work_items.title: Signed embed SDK for dashboards
work_items.description: Embed dashboards in customer portals using signed, expiring tokens. Not started; no forecast.
acceptance_criteria: Embeds require a signed token that expires within 24 hours.
Row-level filters can be bound into the token.

work_items.title: Configurable anomaly alert sensitivity
work_items.description: Adds a per-alert sensitivity setting (low/medium/high) for anomaly alerts.
acceptance_criteria: Each anomaly alert has a sensitivity setting.
Default remains medium.

work_items.title: Warehouse sync lag after schema change
work_items.description: Large schema changes trigger a full backfill which delays incremental syncs by several hours.
acceptance_criteria: Schema changes trigger column-level backfill only.
Incremental lag stays under 30 minutes during backfill.
